_what: Routes the live cross-tenant sweep measured as defective and this pass could not repair. Every entry is a DEFECT against ticket 15's box, not an allowance: a route not listed here that misbehaves fails the suite, and repairing one means deleting its line. Every entry must also carry a line in _reasons — the spec fails a pin with no reason, so the list cannot be padded silently.
_measured: bola-head-full.json, 2026-09-03, 1,929 object-addressable routes probed live against scratch_t15r2 (journal head, two ENTERPRISE tenants, RLS live as streamline_app). See reports/15h-every-object-addressable-route-probed.md.

_reasons.DELETE /contacts/:contactId -> 204: EXCLUDED SCOPE — contacts/CRM are out of this release. 204 whether the contact existed or not; a retry cannot tell a delete from a no-op.
_reasons.GET /crm/consent/contacts/:contactId ->: EXCLUDED SCOPE — CRM. The write verb on the same path is a measured leak; see leaks below.
_reasons.GET /inventory/warehouses/:warehouseId/l: EXCLUDED SCOPE — inventory is out of this release.
_reasons.GET /public/kb/widget/:orgId -> 200: NOT A CROSS-TENANT PROBE — @Public() route whose path :orgId IS the tenant selector. The sweep binds an org parameter to the SOURCE org for the control, the probe and the absent-id request alike, so all three answers are identical by construction and nothing was asked. The surface is asserted by bola-public-org-selector.spec.ts, not by this box.
_reasons.GET /public/kb/widget/:orgId/script -> 2: NOT A CROSS-TENANT PROBE — same @Public() org selector.
_reasons.GET /public/org/:orgId -> 200: NOT A CROSS-TENANT PROBE — same @Public() org selector. Read in source: OrgService.getOrgName does 404 an organisation that does not exist.
_reasons.DELETE /billing/marketplace/:appId/insta: NOT A CROSS-TENANT PROBE — :appId is a row in the global marketplace_apps catalog. The DELETE removes the CALLER's own installation record (scoped by u.orgId from the JWT) — the prober uninstalls the app it installed in its own org during the BOLA install probe. No source-org installation record is read, written or deleted.
_reasons.POST /billing/marketplace/:appId/install: NOT A CROSS-TENANT PROBE — :appId is a row in the global marketplace_apps catalog. The POST creates an installation record scoped to the CALLER's own org (u.orgId from JWT) — the prober installs the app in its own org, not the source org. No source-org installation record is read, written or accessed.
_reasons.PATCH /leads/:leadId/status -> 409: EXCLUDED SCOPE — CRM. The cross-tenant answer is 409, not 404; the control succeeded, so the route is scored and the verdict is inconclusive rather than a pass.
